dbeBinding.name: addAnimationByIndices
dbeBinding.explanation: The callbackScope binding is implemented and exercised by the profile-specific native fixture; its tagged-sprite scope and any API differences are described in the contract.

evidence.note: Compared with pinned Psych 0.6.3 FunkinLua.hx:1810 and addAnimByIndices at :3199; DBE LuaScript.hx implementation. Native objects-rendering fixture verifies Bool return, index parsing, first-animation playback, and loop=false even when an extra true argument is passed; run log: export/compat-tests/psych-lua-0.6.3-ef329610533540d4a58884e738eccc5c.stdout.log.

signature.observation: Ordered arguments and profile defaults extracted from the pinned Psych callback; accepted DBE values are bounded by the documented preconditions.

defaults.psych: Profile-specific parameter defaults are captured on each optional parameter.

return.conversion: Psych helper returns true when a target sprite is found and false otherwise; linc_luajit converts Bool to Lua boolean.

effects: Registers a non-looping animation using comma-separated frame indices.
Starts the new animation when no animation is currently active.
preconditions: obj must resolve to a DBE Lua sprite with loaded frames.
Psych 0.6.3 indices is a comma-separated string; loop is fixed false and is not a parameter.

errors.behavior: DBE returns false for a missing/frameless tag or unsupported index input. Psych 0.6.3 calls trim on indices, so malformed or non-string indices may raise; such inputs are outside the adapted contract.

dbeBinding.name: addAnimationByPrefix
dbeBinding.explanation: The callbackScope binding is implemented and exercised by the profile-specific native fixture; its tagged-sprite scope and any API differences are described in the contract.

evidence.note: Compared with pinned Psych 0.6.3 FunkinLua.hx:1772 and DBE LuaScript.hx binding/implementation. Native objects-rendering fixture verifies nil return and first-animation playback; run log: export/compat-tests/psych-lua-0.6.3-ef329610533540d4a58884e738eccc5c.stdout.log.

signature.observation: Ordered arguments and profile defaults extracted from the pinned Psych callback; accepted DBE values are bounded by the documented preconditions.

defaults.psych: Profile-specific parameter defaults are captured on each optional parameter.

return.conversion: Psych 0.6.3 returns no value; DBE callback maps its void result to Lua nil.

effects: Registers a prefix animation on a Lua-created sprite.
Starts the new animation when no animation is currently active.
preconditions: obj must resolve to a DBE Lua sprite with loaded frames; Psych also resolves named engine fields, which DBE does not expose through this binding.

errors.behavior: Missing or frameless DBE tags return nil without registering an animation; Psych silently skips a missing target. Other engine-field targets are outside the adapted DBE scope.
